name: dev-workspace
postCreateCommand:
bash -eu -c '
if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/code" ]; then exit 0; fi
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=x64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported VS Code CLI architecture" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap "rm -rf $tmp" EXIT
curl -fL "https://update.code.visualstudio.com/latest/cli-linux-$arch/stable" -o "$tmp/code.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$tmp/code.tar.gz" -C "$tmp"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
install -m 755 "$tmp/code" "$HOME/.local/bin/code"
'
